articles.title: Trump defends data centers in Ohio as he rallies to boost Jon Husted in a tight Senate race
articles.description: President Donald Trump is defending data centers powering AI projects during a campaign rally in Ohio. He insists they benefit local communities and warns against losing them to China. The topic is contentious, especially in Ohio's Senate race. Republican Sen. Jon Husted faces criticism for supporting data centers, which some blame for high energy costs. Trump is on a 32-day campaign tour before the November elections, focusing on battleground states like Ohio. The state is crucial for Democrats aiming to flip the Senate. Meanwhile, Republican Vivek Ramaswamy faces a tight governor's race against Democrat Dr. Amy Acton.
